map.由内压求纵向应力 使用指南: Longitudinal Stress from Internal Pressure User Guide
map.输入薄壁圆筒内压 p、半径 r 与壁厚 t，按 σ_l=p·r/(2t) 计算纵: Enter thin-walled cylinder internal pressure p, radius r and wall thickness t and compute longitudinal stress as σ_l = p·r/(2t), for axial strength checks of closed pressure vessels under internal pressure; the value is exactly half the hoop stress.
map.输入内压 p、半径 r、壁厚 t，求纵向应力。: Enter internal pressure p, radius r and wall thickness t to get longitudinal stress.
map.薄壁圆筒内压引起的轴向（纵向）应力。: Axial (longitudinal) stress from internal pressure in a thin-walled cylinder.
map.封头与筒体连接强度评定。: Strength assessment of the head-to-shell joint.
map.：σl=50 MPa 恰为环向应力 100 MPa 的一半。: : σl = 50 MPa is exactly half the hoop stress of 100 MPa.
map.由直径求实心圆截面惯性矩: Solid Circular Section Moment of Inertia from Diameter
map.由直径求实心圆截面极惯性矩: Solid Circular Section Polar Moment of Inertia from Diameter
map.纵向由封头平衡全截面压力，环向由单位长度两侧拉力平衡，几何上差 2 倍。: Longitudinally the head balances pressure over the whole section, while circumferentially the tension on both sides per unit length balances it, a factor of 2 apart geometrically.
map.若有轴向荷载或温差，需与内压纵向应力叠加。: If there is axial load or temperature difference, it must be superimposed on the internal-pressure longitudinal stress.
